Bug `nickelic-lazuline-gonolek` (51e0-5038-bf00-4653) implements the core of this idea. Its explicit post-write maintenance step now runs `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --task=commit-graph --task=loose-objects --task=incremental-repack`, with no gc task and no reachability walk.

Every bounded git child now runs with `maintenance.auto=false` and `gc.auto=0`. The change is pending in Gerrit.

Measured on a copy of the production store, which has 1.07M objects and 2 vCPU, with the run capped at 1 CPU:
- Incremental tasks: 0.35 s, or 17.3 s when incremental-repack fires.
- `gc --auto`: 133.9 s.
- Full repack: 605.6 s.

Not covered: geometric repacking. git 2.47 has no geometric maintenance task.
